title: GTA 6 made $2 billion on day one? Not official
yt_title: GTA 6 made $2 BILLION on day one? It's only an estimate ❌
description: The $1.84B and $2.36B day-one numbers are Sensor Tower estimates, not Rockstar or Take-Two figures (rumor). Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6M digital copies by the end of launch day. For scale, GTA 5 made about $800M on its first day in 2013 (Take-Two figure). Has Rockstar confirmed any number? Not yet: Take-Two says official sales data is coming soon. How many copies do you think it sold?
rumor_note: Unconfirmed (Sensor Tower estimates): ~24.6M digital copies and ~$2.36B by the end of Nov 19; ~$1.84B on launch morning.

lines.text: Did GTA 6 make two billion on day one? That number is not official.
